note: Snapshot of tools/list using the release default MEM0_USER_ID. A running server can override the user namespace through its environment.

tools.name: add_memory
tools.description: Store a new memory with automatic deduplication and indexing. Use for persisting facts, preferences, or conversation context. Checks for duplicates by default (85% similarity threshold). Returns immediately; background processing handles indexing. Prefer over update_memory for new content. Returns: confirmation text. Side effects: creates memory record, updates search index, may skip if duplicate detected.

messages.description: Conversation messages to store. Use instead of content for multi-turn context. Each message needs role and content fields.

content.description: Plain text content to store. Use instead of messages for simple facts. Either content or messages required, not both.

user_id.description: User namespace for memory isolation. Default: "oliver". Use consistent IDs to retrieve related memories.

metadata.description: Key-value pairs for categorization (e.g., {category: 'preferences', source: 'onboarding'}). Searchable via search_memory.

priority.description: Cache priority. high: immediate L1 cache (24h TTL). medium: standard processing. low: L2 cache (7d TTL). Default: medium.

async.description: Enable background processing. true: returns immediately, indexes async. false: blocks until complete. Default: true.

skip_duplicate_check.description: Bypass duplicate detection. Use only when intentionally storing similar content. Default: false.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Retrieve a single memory by its unique ID. Use when you have a specific memory_id from prior search/list results. Returns null if not found. Prefer search_memory for content-based lookup. Read-only operation. Returns: Memory object {id, content, user_id, metadata} or null.

memory_id.description: Unique identifier of the memory to retrieve. Obtained from add_memory response, search_memory results, or get_all_memories.

user_id.description: User namespace. Must match the user_id used when memory was created. Default: "oliver".

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Modify an existing memory's content or metadata. Use for corrections or adding context to existing memories. Fails if memory_id not found. Prefer add_memory for new content. Invalidates search cache. Returns: updated Memory object. Side effects: modifies memory record, invalidates cached search results.

memory_id.description: Unique identifier of the memory to update. Must exist or operation fails with error.

content.description: New content to replace existing. Omit to keep current content unchanged.

metadata.description: Metadata fields to merge. Existing fields not specified are preserved. Pass null value to remove a field.

user_id.description: User namespace. Must match original. Default: "oliver".

tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Find memories matching a natural language query using hybrid semantic + keyword search. Primary retrieval tool for content-based lookup. Uses vector similarity (enhanced mode) or keyword matching (basic mode). Cache-first by default for speed. Returns ranked results with relevance scores. Read-only. Returns: array of Memory objects or 'No memories found' text.

query.description: Natural language search query. Supports keywords, phrases, or questions. More specific queries yield better relevance ranking.

user_id.description: User namespace to search within. Default: "oliver".

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Range: 1-100. Higher values increase latency. Default: 10.

prefer_cache.description: true: check cache first, fall back to storage. false: query storage directly, then cache results. Default: true.

tools.name: get_all_memories
tools.description: List all memories for a user with pagination. Use for browsing or bulk operations. For content search, use search_memory instead. Cache-first by default. Large result sets are automatically truncated. Read-only. Returns: {total, limit, offset, returned, hasMore, source, memories[]}.

limit.description: Maximum memories per page. Range: 1-500. Default: 100. Use with offset for pagination.

offset.description: Number of memories to skip. Use for pagination: page N = offset (N-1)*limit. Default: 0.

include_cache_stats.description: Append cache statistics to response. Useful for monitoring. Default: true.

prefer_cache.description: true: return cached memories (faster). false: fetch from storage (fresher). Default: true.

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Permanently remove a memory by ID. Irreversible operation. Removes from storage, cache, and search index. Use deduplicate_memories with dry_run first to preview bulk deletions. Returns: confirmation text. Side effects: deletes memory record, removes from all indexes, invalidates cache.

memory_id.description: Unique identifier of memory to delete. Obtain from search_memory or get_all_memories. Operation succeeds even if ID not found.

tools.name: deduplicate_memories
tools.description: Detect and optionally remove duplicate memories using content similarity. Run with dry_run=true first to preview. Compares all memories pairwise using Jaccard similarity. Groups duplicates with a primary (oldest) and candidates for removal. Returns: summary with duplicate groups. Side effects (when dry_run=false): deletes duplicate memories, invalidates cache.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum similarity (0-1) to consider as duplicate. 0.85 = 85% similar. Higher = stricter. Range: 0.5-1.0. Default: 0.85.

dry_run.description: true: preview duplicates without deletion (safe). false: actually delete duplicates (destructive). Default: true.

tools.name: optimize_cache
tools.description: Reorganize cache for optimal hit rates. Promotes frequently accessed memories to L1 (24h TTL), demotes cold data to L2 (7d TTL). Use periodically for large memory stores. May temporarily increase latency during optimization. Returns: summary of cached memories. Side effects: modifies cache TTLs, may evict old entries.

force_refresh.description: true: clear cache and reload all from storage. false: optimize existing cache. Default: false.

max_memories.description: Maximum memories to keep in cache. Range: 100-10000. Older/colder items evicted first. Default: 1000.

tools.name: cache_stats
tools.description: View cache performance metrics and health status. Use for monitoring and debugging. Shows memory count, access patterns, and hit rates. Read-only. Returns: summary text with cached memory count. No side effects.

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Check background job queue and sync status. Shows pending async operations from add_memory calls. Use to verify all writes completed. Read-only. Returns: count of pending operations or 'All operations complete'. No side effects.

tools.name: extract_entities
tools.description: Extract named entities and relationships from text using NLP. Identifies people, organizations, technologies, and projects. Also extracts relationships (WORKS_FOR, USES, etc.) and keywords. Requires enhanced intelligence mode. Read-only, stateless. Returns: {people[], organizations[], technologies[], projects[], relationships[], keywords[]}.

text.description: Input text to analyze. Longer text yields more entities. Supports natural language, code comments, or structured text.

tools.name: get_knowledge_graph
tools.description: Build a knowledge graph from stored memories. Returns entities as nodes and relationships as edges. Use for visualizing connections between concepts. Requires enhanced intelligence mode with prior entity extraction. Read-only. Returns: {nodes[], edges[]} where nodes have {id, type, name, memories[]} and edges have {from, to, type, confidence}.

entity_type.description: Filter nodes by type: 'people', 'organizations', 'technologies', or 'projects'. Omit for all types.

entity_name.description: Filter nodes containing this name (case-insensitive substring match). Omit for all entities.

relationship_type.description: Filter edges by relationship: 'WORKS_FOR', 'USES', 'BUILT_WITH', 'KNOWS', etc. Omit for all relationships.

limit.description: Maximum nodes to return. Range: 1-100. Default: 20. Edges limited proportionally.

tools.name: find_connections
tools.description: Discover relationship paths between entities in the knowledge graph. Uses BFS traversal to find how entities connect. Useful for answering 'how is X related to Y?' questions. Requires enhanced mode. Read-only. Returns: {from, to, max_depth, paths_found, paths[]} where each path is array of {from, to, type} edges.

from_entity.description: Starting entity name for path search. Must match an entity in the knowledge graph exactly.

to_entity.description: Target entity name. If omitted, returns all reachable entities up to max_depth.

max_depth.description: Maximum relationship hops to traverse. Range: 1-5. Higher values exponentially increase results. Default: 2.

tools.name: import_memories
tools.description: Bulk import memories from external sources. Supports Mem0 API export or local JSON files. Processes in batches with duplicate detection. Use for migration or backup restoration. Returns: summary with imported/skipped/failed counts. Side effects: creates multiple memory records, updates search index.

source.description: Import source. 'mem0_api': fetch from Mem0 cloud (requires api_key). 'json_file': read local file (requires file_path).

api_key.description: Mem0 API token for authentication. Required when source='mem0_api'. Get from https://mem0.ai dashboard.

user_id.description: User namespace for imported memories. Default: "oliver".

file_path.description: Absolute path to JSON file. Required when source='json_file'. Must be array of memory objects or {memories: [...]}.

batch_size.description: Memories per batch. Lower values are safer but slower. Range: 10-200. Default: 50.

priority.description: Cache priority for all imported memories. Default: high (L1 cache).

skip_duplicates.description: Check each memory for duplicates before import. Slower but prevents bloat. Default: true.
